clips.title: The story
paras: Gornek gives hunters in the Valley of Trials a summons from Jen'shan. The Etched Parchment points them toward their first lessons in Durotar.

Young orcs and Darkspear trolls begin their rites in the Valley of Trials. As recruits prove themselves against the local vermin, Gornek guides them toward their calling. He gives the Etched Parchment to those who will wield bow, gun, and fang. Its message comes from Jen'shan, a skilled hunter trainer seeking fresh eyes and steady hands.

Taking the parchment to Jen'shan begins a hunter's training in Durotar. She teaches that the wild path takes dedication: mastering the beasts of the desert demands as much effort as an arcanist's magic or a shaman's work with the spirits. Her summons brings new hunters to lessons in marksmanship and wilderness survival.
